wish: someone should make an app that buzzes me when I've talked too long
spec:
Listens to the microphone and counts continuous speaking time; past your limit it vibrates and beeps, repeating every 10 seconds.
Tap Listen, set the limit with + and -, and talk; silence of 3 seconds resets the count. I'm talking is a hand timer when the mic is denied.
It does not record, transcribe or send audio anywhere; vibration works only on devices that support it.
notes: Microphone level only, no speech recognition. Vibration is unsupported on iOS Safari; the beep still plays.
